text:
Yesterday I saw you

in the street,

Myriam and


I saw you so beautiful,

Myriam, that


(how can I explain

how beautiful I saw you!)


Not even you, Myriam,

can see yourself

so beautiful

or imagine

that you can be

so beautiful to me

and I saw you so beautiful

that it seems that


No woman

is more beautiful than you


No man in love

sees any woman

so beautiful,

Myriam,

as I see you


And not even you yourself,

Myriam,

are perhaps

so beautiful


Why

can so much beauty

not be real!


As beautiful as I saw you

yesterday in the street


Or as today it seems to me,

Myriam

that I saw you

translation.title: Yesterday I Saw You
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the breathless repetitions and the slightly dangling 'Myriam and' from the source.
